model.name: Advertisement / Promotion
model.purpose: Represent a governed promotional-instrument specification family with discriminated advertisement and sales-promotion profiles so agents can understand claims, evidence, disclosures, creative and placement bindings, benefit mechanics, terms, lifecycle, observations and remedies without confusing approval with legality, release with dissemination, exposure with effectiveness or redemption with settlement.
model.scope_statement: Owns promotional-record identity, mandatory advertisement-versus-sales-promotion discriminator, revisions, profiles and state; sponsor, advertiser, beneficiary, payer, responsible-party, publisher, platform, agency, endorser, seller and intermediary role bindings; promoted-subject, proposition, claim, qualification, omission, comparative basis, evidence, test, endorsement, material connection, sponsorship and required-disclosure assertions; creative, content, language, format, accessibility, ad-marking, native-separation, interactivity and rights bindings; channel, placement, inventory, schedule, frequency, seller authorization and supply-path references; promotion benefit, coupon, discount, reward, value, eligibility, exclusions, quantity, window, territory, terms, entry and redemption instructions; external redemption, clearing and settlement references; draft, review, approval, release, pause, withdrawal, expiry, supersession and correction states; external serve, impression, viewability, interaction, conversion and redemption observations; targeting, privacy, minors, vulnerability, prohibited use, brand safety, complaint, challenge, takedown, regulator and dispute references; distinct clocks, provenance, quality, access, retention, validation and loss-aware projections. External campaign, creative work, product, service, offer, price, party, audience, consent, placement, inventory, communication, observation, order, contract, payment, ledger, enforcement and records masters remain authoritative.
in_scope: Promotional identity, advertisement and sales-promotion subtypes, parties, claims, evidence, endorsement, sponsorship, disclosure, creative, media and placement bindings

Promotion mechanics, benefits, eligibility, exclusions, terms, lifecycle, external observations, targeting safeguards, complaints, corrections, clocks, provenance, access, retention, validation and projections
out_of_scope: Owning Campaign, Creative Work, Content, Product, Service, Offer, Price, Party, Audience, Segment, Contact Point, Consent, Preference, Placement, Inventory, Communication, Delivery, Interaction, Observation, Order, Contract, Invoice, Payment, Ledger, Complaint, Enforcement Case or Records masters

Treating advertisement and sales promotion as one undifferentiated instance type, or treating claim, evidence, approval, legality, release, serve, impression, viewability, response, conversion, redemption and settlement as mutually proving states

Autonomous protected-group targeting, sensitive-attribute inference, claim invention, evidence fabrication, endorsement, hidden advertising, content publication, media purchase, benefit commitment, contact, personal-data disclosure or record destruction

boundary_notes.distinction: The unified registry supplies a provisional parent signal only. Advertisement is a governed promotional use and claim context that binds an exact creative revision; it does not own the creative work, expression or rights lifecycle.

A campaign coordinates objectives, audience, channels, schedule, budget and measurement. This model defines the promotional instrument, claim, disclosure, creative or benefit mechanics bound into that campaign.

boundary_notes.neighbor: Offer, Price, Product, Service, Coupon, Order, Payment and Ledger
boundary_notes.distinction: A sales promotion describes presented benefit mechanics and terms; authoritative eligibility, entitlement, transaction, redemption, clearing, settlement and accounting outcomes remain external.

boundary_notes.neighbor: Placement, delivery, impression, viewability, interaction and conversion
boundary_notes.distinction: The promotional record binds intended media and technical profiles. Every dissemination or performance fact is an independently identified source-qualified observation.

boundary_notes.neighbor: IAB, GS1, EU, FTC, RFC, PROV, DQV, ODRL and OpenAPI
boundary_notes.distinction: Each representation covers a channel, promotion, jurisdiction, temporal, provenance, quality, policy or API facet; every mapping is version-pinned, profile-qualified and loss-declaring.
